items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Then we made some -- Stanley Dance came over.

ctx.x: Un-huh. And I'll try to get one to you. It's -- I'll try to get you one. And we did one in '54, we made an album for -- what the hell was the name of that -- I'm trying to remember the name of the -- Batan, it was a Batan label, B-a-t-a-n, but he sold it and I've heard them things on like now two different labels and that's why it's so confusing to me, you know? But it was originally Batan label by a Jewish fella by the name of Saul Rabinowitz He was the President of that company. And they were very -- that was a…
Then we made some -- Stanley Dance came over. Oh,
yeah, I think that's the best. That was the best one, on Felstead
